summary: Frontend-only retest of the two changed pages plus homepage regression (desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844). Events page now correctly splits into Upcoming (1 card: 'AI & Machine Learning Career Workshop', 2026-10-01) and Past (4 cards) with correct counters; event detail modal opens/closes. Contact page has no media@etieducom.com anywhere (HTML+text checked), 'Franchisee & Founder Connect' -> director@etieducom.com, 'General & Student Queries' -> helpdesk@etieducom.com, Partnerships -> partnerships@etieducom.com; only 3 mailto links exist, layout intact after card removal on both viewports. Homepage regression passed: 'Recent Events' section (data-testid=events-section) with 4 completed events, announcement bar, 'Our Recruiters' marquee and 'Our Students, Placed' sections render; top nav 'Contact' link clickable after scrolling and navigates. Zero console errors and zero error-class elements observed. No leads were submitted (CRM safe).

issues: Bar text wraps to 3 lines and the 'Enquire Now' link visually collides/overlaps with the close (X) button at the right edge — tight spacing, no right padding reserved for the dismiss button

action_items: Optional polish: add right padding/gap in the mobile announcement bar so 'Enquire Now' does not overlap the dismiss (X) button
critical_code_review_comments: EventsPageClient EventCard shows the raw ISO event_date (e.g. '2026-10-01') on cards while the modal shows a formatted date; consider using formatDate() on cards for consistency with the homepage cards which show '10 Dec 2025'.
Event cards are clickable divs without role/tabIndex/keyboard handler — not keyboard accessible; consider a button wrapper.
Event modal lacks a data-testid and Escape-key/backdrop close handling.
seed_data_creation: None created; used existing seeded events (5 total: 1 future, 4 past).
test_credentials: Admin not required for these tests; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Events page upcoming/past split relies on client-side date comparison vs system date (container date = 2026-09-01). The single upcoming event is dated 2026-10-01 — it will move to 'Past Events' after that date and the 'no-upcoming-events' empty state would then appear; reseed a future event before retesting. Contact page verified free of media@ and krishna@ emails. Homepage placed-students heading is 'Our Students, Placed' (not 'Placed Students') — use that string for assertions.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all requested fixes verified working.
